definitions.explanation: A person who manages a business, team, or performer. In Japanese schools and clubs, also the student who handles a sports team's logistics and support rather than playing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧マネージャー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Become the manager of the shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野球部|やきゅうぶ}→野球部：27441_yakyuubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧マネージャー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: Serve as the baseball club's manager.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧マネージャー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧や⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new manager is in charge of the team's schedule and equipment.

notes:
From English "manager." Covers a business or store manager as well as, in schools, the club マネージャー who handles support tasks. Also used for the manager of an entertainer or musician.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦エリア→エリア：10726_eria⟧マネージャー: area manager
- マネージャー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as manager
- ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧マネージャー: club manager

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{管理者|かんりしゃ}→管理者：24297_kanrisha⟧: administrator — more formal, administrative
- ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧: coach; director — leads or directs a team or film
